diagnosis: The endpoint queries BullMQ for a completed job using jobId from the URL parameter and immediately returns job.returnvalue.s3PresignedUrl. It fails to verify that job.data.requestedBy matches req.user.id, allowing any authenticated user to download payroll or customer data exports generated by others.
exploit_request:
GET /api/exports/job_exp_tax_q4_8819/download HTTP/1.1
Host: app.bi-platform.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
